items.condition: The submission changes the supplied molecular connectivity, protonation, stoichiometry, charge, or multiplicity, or fails to identify candidate structures unambiguously.
The submission claims a minimum or strongest candidate without optimization status and candidate-specific stationary-point validation evidence.
Interaction energies are compared using inconsistent monomer references, mixed units, or an undefined sign convention.
The submission gives a discovery claim without candidate-generation rules, deduplication, attempted/advanced counts, stopping condition, or coverage limitations.
The conclusion presents an isolated gas-phase molecular calculation as proof of solution, solid-state, perovskite-interface, or device behavior.
